summary.en: Getting started under a musical break: the title decodes in two halves, a terminal rises and its commands type at reading pace, then the title and terminal leave and two to four step cards land alone, one a beat, on the drop.
summary.zh: 在音乐的停顿里讲怎么开始：标题分两半解码出现，终端升起、命令按阅读速度敲出；随后标题和终端退场，二到四张步骤卡在落拍上一拍一张单独落下。

fits: The rest before the climax of a CLI film: how to install, and the verbs the film has shown, as cards.
notFor: More than two commands; steps that are not the film's own chapters; a product without a command line.

intent.en: Show how little it takes to start, then recap the film as the verbs you will type.
intent.zh: 先说明开始有多简单，再用你会敲的那几个动词把整片回顾一遍。

content.en: A title (≤ 4 words, or its two halves), the window's title and right label, 1–2 commands, 2–4 steps of a command and a label (≤ 4 words).
content.zh: 一句标题（≤ 12 字，或给出两半）、窗口标题和右侧标签、1–2 条命令、2–4 个步骤（命令 + ≤ 8 字说明）。

fits.zh: 命令行工具片子高潮前的停顿：怎么安装，再把片子讲过的动词做成卡片。

notFor.zh: 超过两条命令；步骤不是片子自己的章节；没有命令行的产品。

en: Time the host adds goes before the cards, not after them: the cards keep their own length into the climax.
zh: 宿主加出来的时间放在卡片之前，不放在之后：卡片保持自己的长度接进高潮。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
